gen-gf-offside-gf-radio-canada-big: Offside leaves its curves stubbornly open, tracked wide and held at one quiet level. Radio Canada Big takes over below with a tall x-height that fills the line, and its terminals stop well short of the stem, so a long stretch of text moves along easily.
gen-gf-offside-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps a plain sans steadiness, its terminals gapped wide and its weight unvarying from word to word. And Offside is the showier one, making its commanding statement with open curves and wide tracking while the body simply carries on.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-schibste: Love Ya Like A Sister has ascenders that barely clear the x-height, giving it a bold, stubby swagger. And Schibsted Grotesk, a plain sans with open, tall-bowled e and a shapes, would sit nicely a few sizes smaller beneath it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sintony: Metamorphous has stencil-cut letters with mildly varied bar widths. Sintony is the smooth sans-serif partner, its chunky, tall midzone and unclogged curves giving the pair a crisp, modern clarity under that carved, commanding top line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-roboto: Roboto reads with generous, open mouths on its round letters. Offside earns its keep big and short, where its thin joins, no thinner than the stems, and its widely tracked, unclosed curves can make a statement.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplement: Eater runs a lightly shaded texture through every word, dark and aggressive. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement answers with round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Wire-bent s curves and a towering, pencil-stub x-height make Flavors look playful yet commanding. Noto Sans Tamil reads magnified and open, terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Autour One draws every stroke with zero modulation, so its bold, round forms feel poured rather than written. Noto Sans Tangsa does the quieter job, with wide, inviting openings on round letters and short ascender stems that keep the sans-serif text approachable.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Tiled, futuristic letters with wide grout lines between them. Noto Sans Brahmi follows with a high mean line and open-ended curves, so a longer passage should read in an unhurried, contemporary way beneath the identical bar thickness of Audiowide.
gen-almendra-display-gf-lexend-zetta: Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut, giving it an ornate, literary feel. Lexend Zetta does the plainer work, its sans-serif strokes like cut ribbon of constant width, tall-bodied and widely tracked.
